description: This file contains implementation of tree similarity scoring, tree matching, and tree manipulation functions for Git repositories, including functions for comparing, splicing, and shifting trees based on their object IDs.

methods.name: int score_missing(unsigned mode)
methods.description: Returns a score penalty based on missing modes (directory, symlink, or other).

methods.name: int score_differs(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Returns a score penalty when modes differ between two tree entries.

methods.name: int score_matches(unsigned mode1,unsigned mode2)
methods.description: Returns a high score when modes match and are of the same type (directory, symlink, or other).

methods.name: void * fill_tree_desc_strict(struct repository * r,struct tree_desc * desc,const struct object_id * hash)
methods.description: Reads a tree object from the repository and initializes a tree description structure.

methods.name: int base_name_entries_compare(const struct name_entry * a,const struct name_entry * b)
methods.description: Compares two tree entries based on their base names, modes, and lengths.

methods.name: int score_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2)
methods.description: Calculates a similarity score between two trees based on matching entries.

methods.name: void match_trees(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,int * best_score,char ** best_match,const char * base,int recurse_limit)
methods.description: Recursively matches subtrees and finds the best matching subtree to maximize similarity score.

methods.name: int splice_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid1,const char * prefix,const struct object_id * oid2,struct object_id * result)
methods.description: Replaces a subdirectory in one tree with another tree object, effectively splicing trees at a given prefix.

methods.name: void shift_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,int depth_limit)
methods.description: Generates a shifted version of one tree to match the structure of another by prefixing or replacing subtrees.

methods.name: void shift_tree_by(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * hash1,const struct object_id * hash2,struct object_id * shifted,const char * shift_prefix)
methods.description: Shifts a tree based on a shift prefix, trying to align trees by either adding or removing a prefix.
